# Load and Organize Data

```{r}
seed = 1
set.seed(1)
# Load data from southern African database

# set directory
dir = here::here()

# Load data from external code
za_count <- read_csv(paste0(dir, "/data/za_count_site.csv"))
za_count_taph <- read_csv(paste0(dir, '/data/za_count_site_taph.csv'))

# read in and modify data names and assign as date list for c14bazAAR
c14_za <- read_csv(paste0(dir, "/data/SARD_Mar2021_14C.csv")) %>%
  rename(labnr = 'Lab ID',
         lon = DecdegE, lat = DecdegS,
         material = 'Material dated', species = Species,
         SiteType = `Site Type`) %>%
  
  right_join(read_csv(paste0(dir, "/data/Merged_C14.csv")), 
             by = c('Site', 'labnr')) %>%
  
  mutate(c14age = as.numeric(c14age),
         c14std = as.numeric(c14std),
         
         Industry = ifelse(Industry == 'Ceramic LSA', 'Ceramic Final LSA',
                           Industry),
         
         labnr = ifelse((str_detect(labnr, '\x86')), 
                        str_remove(labnr, '\x86'), labnr)) %>%
  filter(Industry %in% c('Robberg', 'Oakhurst',
                         'Wilton', 'Ceramic LSA', 'Final LSA')) %>%
  
  as.c14_date_list()

za_df <- za_count %>%
  left_join(c14_za %>% 
               select(Site, labnr, Industry, `SiteType`, lat, lon, Country),
             by = c('Site', 'labnr')) %>%
  group_by(site_bins) %>%
  arrange(Industry) %>%
  mutate(Industry = first(Industry)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  arrange(lat) %>%
  mutate(lat = first(lat),
         lon = first(lon)) %>%
  arrange(Country) %>%
  mutate(Country = first(Country)) %>%
  arrange(`SiteType`) %>%
  mutate(`Site Type` = first(`SiteType`)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(SiteType = ifelse(`SiteType` %in% c('shell midden', 
                                              'settlement'),
                           'Intensification', 
                           ifelse(is.na(`SiteType`), 'Unknown', 
                                  `SiteType`)),
         SiteType = factor(SiteType),
         Zone_Name = factor(Zone_Name))



za_df_taph <- za_count_taph %>%
  left_join(c14_za %>% 
              select(Site, labnr, Industry, `SiteType`, lat, lon, Country),
            by = c('Site', 'labnr')) %>%
  group_by(site_bins) %>%
  arrange(Industry) %>%
  mutate(Industry = first(Industry)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  arrange(lat) %>%
  mutate(lat = first(lat),
         lon = first(lon)) %>%
  arrange(Country) %>%
  mutate(Country = first(Country)) %>%
  arrange(`SiteType`) %>%
  mutate(`SiteType` = first(`SiteType`)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(SiteType = ifelse(`SiteType` %in% c('shell midden', 
                                              'settlement'),
                           'Intensification', 
                           ifelse(is.na(`SiteType`), 'Unknown', 
                                  `SiteType`)),
         SiteType = factor(SiteType),
         Zone_Name = factor(Zone_Name))


boundaries <- read_csv(paste0(dir, '/data/boundaries.csv')) %>%
  mutate(Phase = ifelse(Industry != 'Final LSA',
                        str_split_i(Culture, '_', 2),
                        str_split_i(Culture, '_', 3))) %>%
  select(-c(Culture, upr, lwr)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Phase, values_from = median) %>%
  mutate(Industry = factor(Industry, levels = c('Final LSA', 'Wilton', 
                                                'Oakhurst', 'Robberg')))
```

# Hierarchical Analysis

```{r}

fit_df <- za_df %>%
  group_by(calBP) %>%
  summarize(
    site_count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    median_calBP = calBP,
    time_ka = -(calBP - mean(calBP, na.rm = TRUE)) / 1000
  )

fit_df_taph <- za_df_taph %>%
  group_by(calBP) %>%
  summarize(
    site_count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    median_calBP = calBP,
    time_ka = -(calBP - mean(calBP, na.rm = TRUE)) / 1000
  )


fit_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = calBP, y = site_count, fill = site_count))+
  geom_line() +
  xlab("Calibrated Years BP") +
  ylab("Radiocarbon Count") +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,  hjust = 1)) -> count_map



fit_df_taph %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = calBP, y = site_count, fill = site_count))+
  geom_line() +
  xlab("Calibrated Years BP") +
  ylab("Radiocarbon Count") +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,  hjust = 1)) -> count_map_taph

png(paste0(dir, "/results/figures/map1.png"), 
    width = 1200, height = 800, res = 300)

ggarrange(
  count_map, count_map_taph,
  labels = c("A", "B"),
  vjust = 1.2, hjust = 0
)

dev.off()
```

## Site count Vs Time

### 0 CP

```{r}

# this model shows cluster show almost no variation after accounting for mean site count
my_prior <-
  prior(normal(0, 1), class ='Intercept')+
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = 'b')+
  
  prior(beta(1, 1), class = 'zi')

seed <- 77177
fit_space <- brm(
  site_count ~ 1 + s(time_ka),
  
  family = zero_inflated_poisson(),
  
  data = fit_df,
  
  prior = my_prior,
  
  chains = 1,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(8),
  backend = 'cmdstanr',
  seed = seed
)


seed <- 77277
fit_space_taph <- brm(
  site_count ~ 1 + s(time_ka),
  
  family = zero_inflated_poisson(),
  
  data = fit_df_taph,
  
  prior = my_prior,
  
  chains = 1,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(8),
  backend = 'cmdstanr',
  seed = seed
)

```

#### Uncorrected count data

```{r}
pred_grid <- tibble(
    time_ka = seq(
      min(fit_df$time_ka, na.rm = TRUE),
      max(fit_df$time_ka, na.rm = TRUE),
      length.out = 1000
    )
  )

pred <- posterior_epred(
  fit_space,
  newdata = pred_grid,
  re_formula = NULL,
  allow_new_levels = TRUE
)


pred_summary <- pred %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  setNames(paste0("draw_", seq_len(ncol(.)))) %>%
  bind_cols(pred_grid) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("draw_"),
    names_to = "draw",
    values_to = "mu"
  ) %>%
  group_by(time_ka) %>%
  summarise(
    estimate = median(mu),
    lower = quantile(mu, 0.025),
    upper = quantile(mu, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(calBP = (-time_ka * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP)) %>%
  filter(calBP < 27000, calBP > 500)


###############################
# compute the slope summary
pred_grid_full <- tibble(
  time_ka = seq(
    min(fit_df$time_ka, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(fit_df$time_ka, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = nrow(fit_df)
  )
)

pred_full <- posterior_epred(
  fit_space,
  newdata = pred_grid_full,
  re_formula = NULL,
  allow_new_levels = TRUE
)



# Difference between adjacent time points
dt <- diff(pred_grid_full$time_ka)

# Posterior slope for each draw
slopes <- (pred_full[, -1] - pred_full[, -ncol(pred_full)]) /
  rep(dt, each = nrow(pred_full))

# Summarize posterior slopes
slope_summary <- data.frame(
  time_ka = pred_grid_full$time_ka[-1] -
    dt / 2,
  slope_mean = colMeans(slopes),
  slope_lower = apply(slopes, 2, quantile, 0.025),
  slope_upper = apply(slopes, 2, quantile, 0.975)
) %>%
  mutate(calBP = (-time_ka * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP))

slope_at_origin <- boundaries %>%
  filter(RFZ == 'ZA') %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    slope_summary %>%
      slice_min(
        abs(calBP - Origin),
        n = 1
      ) %>%
      select(slope_mean, slope_lower, slope_upper)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


slope_at_termination <- boundaries %>%
  filter(RFZ == 'ZA') %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    slope_summary %>%
      slice_min(
        abs(calBP - Termination),
        n = 1
      ) %>%
      select(slope_mean, slope_lower, slope_upper)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


slope_at_boundaries <- rbind(slope_at_origin,
                             slope_at_termination)
```

```{r}
fit_time_0cp_gg <- 
  ggplot() +
  
  # Where the slope is no different than 0
  geom_segment(
    data = slope_summary %>%
      mutate(calBP = round(calBP)) %>%
      filter((slope_upper < 0 & slope_lower > 0) | 
               (slope_upper > 0 & slope_lower < 0)) %>%
      inner_join(
        pred_summary %>%
          mutate(calBP = round(calBP)),
        by = "calBP"
      ), 
    aes(
      x = calBP,
      xend = calBP,
      y = lower,
      yend = upper
    ),
    color = "red"
  ) +
  
  # Reset color scale
  new_scale_color() +
  
  # Observed site counts
  geom_segment(
    data = fit_df %>% filter(calBP > 500, calBP < 27000, site_count > 0),
    aes(
      x = calBP,
      xend = calBP,
      y = -0.02,
      yend = 0,
      color = site_count
    ),
    linewidth = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  
  scale_color_gradient(
    low = "grey85",
    high = "orangered",
    name = "Site count"
  ) +
    
    # Reset color scale
    new_scale_color() +
  
  # Bayesian credible interval
  geom_ribbon(
    data = pred_summary,
    aes(
      x = calBP,
      ymin = lower,
      ymax = upper
    ),
    alpha = 0.25,
    fill = "black",
    color = NA
  ) +
  
  # Posterior mean prediction
  geom_line(
    data = pred_summary,
    aes(
      x = calBP,
      y = estimate
    ),
    linewidth = 0.3,
    color = 'black'
  ) +
  
  # Robberg 
  geom_errorbar(data = boundaries %>% filter(RFZ == 'ZA'),
                aes(xmin = Termination, 
                    xmax = Origin,
                    y = 0.6, color = factor(Industry)), 
                position = 'dodge',
                width = 0.05, 
                linewidth = 0.5) +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Robberg" = "orange",
      "Oakhurst" = "blue",
      "Wilton" = "darkgreen",
      'Final LSA' = "magenta"
    ),
    name = "Technological\nPeriod"
  ) +
  
  # Reset color scale
  new_scale_color() +
  
  # Reverse BP axis
  scale_x_reverse() +
  
  labs(
    x = "Calibrated Years BP",
    y = 'Expected Radiocarbon Count',
    fill = "Site Count"
  ) +
  ylim(-0.02, 0.8) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  
  theme(
    # Reduce the font size of the legend title
    legend.title = element_text(size = 5), 
    
    # Reduce the font size of the legend labels
    legend.text = element_text(size = 4),
    
    # Shrink the size of the keys (the symbols/boxes)
    legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    
    
    axis.title = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 5)
  )

```

### 3 CP

```{r}
# Global change point
hinge_fun <- stanvar(
  scode = "
  real hinge(real x, real cp) {
    return fmax(0, x - cp);
  }
  ",
  block = "functions"
)


# Three change points per region
model_fit_3cp <- bf(
  site_count ~ alpha +
    beta1 * time_ka +
    beta2 * hinge(time_ka, cp1) +
    beta3 * hinge(time_ka, cp2) +
    beta4 * hinge(time_ka, cp3),
  
  alpha ~ 1,
  beta1 ~ 1,
  beta2 ~ 1,
  beta3 ~ 1,
  beta4 ~ 1,
  
  cp1 ~ 1,
  cp2 ~ 1,
  cp3 ~ 1,
  
  nl = TRUE
)


prior_fit_3cp <- c(
  
  # baseline
  prior(
    normal(0, 1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "alpha"
  ),
  
  # initial slope
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta1"
  ),
  
  # slope change at CP1
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta2"
  ),
  
  # additional slope change at CP2
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta3"
  ),
  
  # additional slope change at CP3
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta4"
  ),
  
  # CP1
  # third change point from Robberg to Oakhurst
  prior(
    normal(14, 0.5),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "cp1"
  ),
  
  # CP2
  # second change point from Oakhurst to wilton
  prior(
    normal(9.21, 0.5),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "cp2"
  ),
  
  # CP3
  # last change point from Wilton to final LSA
  prior(
    normal(4.96, 2),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "cp3"
  )
)

seed <- 151617

fit_time_3cp <- brm(
  model_fit_3cp,
  data = fit_df,
  family = zero_inflated_poisson(),
  prior = prior_fit_3cp,
  
  stanvars = hinge_fun,
  
  chains = 1,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(8),
  backend = 'cmdstanr',
  seed = seed,
  
  sample_prior = 'yes'
)


seed <- 15161718

fit_time_3cp_taph <- brm(
  model_fit_3cp,
  data = fit_df_taph,
  family = zero_inflated_poisson(),
  prior = prior_fit_3cp,
  
  stanvars = hinge_fun,
  
  chains = 1,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(8),
  backend = 'cmdstanr',
  seed = seed,
  
  sample_prior = 'yes'
)

```

```{r}
expose_functions(fit_time_3cp, vectorize = TRUE)
# posterior checks for reg data
loo_time_cp3 <- loo(fit_time_3cp)
pp_check(fit_time_3cp)


# posterior checks for taph data
loo_time_cp3_taph <- loo(fit_time_3cp_taph)
pp_check(loo_time_cp3_taph)
```

```{r}
nd <- data.frame(time_ka = seq(min(fit_df$time_ka),
                               max(fit_df$time_ka),
                               0.1))

# draws x zones matrix for each nonlinear parameter
get_par <- function(par) posterior_linpred(fit_time_3cp, newdata = nd, nlpar = par)

p <- lapply(c("beta1","beta2","beta3","beta4","cp1","cp2","cp3"), get_par)
names(p) <- c("beta1","beta2","beta3","beta4","cp1","cp2","cp3")

# Slopes (log-rate per ka), oldest -> youngest segments
# Segment ordering assumes cp1 > cp2 > cp3 (older -> younger)
slopes <- list(
  seg_young_of_cp3   = p$beta1,                              # t < cp3
  seg_cp3_to_cp2     = p$beta1 + p$beta4,                    # cp3 < t < cp2
  seg_cp2_to_cp1     = p$beta1 + p$beta4 + p$beta3,          # cp2 < t < cp1
  seg_older_than_cp1 = p$beta1 + p$beta4 + p$beta3 + p$beta2 # t > cp1
)

summ <- function(m, name) {
  data.frame(
    quantity  = name,
    mean   = colMeans(m),
    median = apply(m, 2, median),
    lower  = apply(m, 2, quantile, 0.025),
    upper  = apply(m, 2, quantile, 0.975)
  )
}

cp_summary <- bind_rows(
  summ(p$cp1, "CP1 (Robberg/Oakhurst)"),
  summ(p$cp2, "CP2 (Oakhurst/Wilton)"),
  summ(p$cp3, "CP3 (Wilton/final LSA)")
) %>%
  distinct(quantity, mean, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(

    calBP_estimate = (-mean * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP),
    calBP_lwr = (-lower * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP),
    calBP_upr = (-upper * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP)
  )

slope_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(names(slopes), 
                                  function(n) summ(slopes[[n]], n))) %>%
  distinct(quantity, mean, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Slope before/after each change point (younger vs older side), plus % change per ka
ba <- list(
  CP3_younger = slopes$seg_young_of_cp3,   CP3_older = slopes$seg_cp3_to_cp2,
  CP2_younger = slopes$seg_cp3_to_cp2,     CP2_older = slopes$seg_cp2_to_cp1,
  CP1_younger = slopes$seg_cp2_to_cp1,     CP1_older = slopes$seg_older_than_cp1
)
ba_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(names(ba), function(n) summ(ba[[n]], n)))
pct_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(names(ba), function(n) summ(exp(ba[[n]]) - 1, paste0(n, "_pct"))))

# Slope change at each CP (just the hinge coefficient), with P(change > 0)
change_summary <- bind_rows(
  summ(p$beta4, "slope change at CP3"),
  summ(p$beta3, "slope change at CP2"),
  summ(p$beta2, "slope change at CP1")
)  %>%
  distinct(quantity, mean, .keep_all = TRUE)

print(change_summary)
```

### 4 CP

```{r}
# Global change point
hinge_fun <- stanvar(
  scode = "
  real hinge(real x, real cp) {
    return fmax(0, x - cp);
  }
  ",
  block = "functions"
)


# Three change points per region
model_fit_4cp <- bf(
  site_count ~ alpha +
    beta1 * time_ka +
    beta2 * hinge(time_ka, cp1) +
    beta3 * hinge(time_ka, cp2) +
    beta4 * hinge(time_ka, cp3) +
    beta5 * hinge(time_ka, cp4) ,
  
  alpha ~ 1,
  beta1 ~ 1,
  beta2 ~ 1,
  beta3 ~ 1,
  beta4 ~ 1,
  beta5 ~ 1,
  
  cp1 ~ 1,
  cp2 ~ 1,
  cp3 ~ 1,
  cp4 ~ 1,
  
  nl = TRUE
)


prior_fit_4cp <- c(
  
  # baseline
  prior(
    normal(0, 1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "alpha"
  ),
  
  # initial slope
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta1"
  ),
  
  # slope change at CP1
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta2"
  ),
  
  # additional slope change at CP2
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta3"
  ),
  
  # additional slope change at CP3
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta4"
  ),
  
  # additional slope change at CP4
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta5"
  ),
  
  # CP1
  # third change point from Robberg to Oakhurst
  prior(
    normal(14, 0.5),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "cp1"
  ),
  
  # CP2
  # second change point from Oakhurst to wilton
  prior(
    normal(9.21, 0.5),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "cp2"
  ),
  
  # CP3
  # last change point from Wilton to final LSA
  prior(
    normal(4.96, 2),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "cp3"
  ),
  
  # CP4
  # last change point from Wilton to final LSA
  prior(
    normal(-7.25, 2),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "cp4"
  )
)

seed <- 1516172

fit_time_4cp <- brm(
  model_fit_4cp,
  data = fit_df,
  family = zero_inflated_poisson(),
  prior = prior_fit_4cp,
  
  stanvars = hinge_fun,
  
  chains = 1,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(8),
  backend = 'cmdstanr',
  seed = seed,
  
  sample_prior = 'yes'
)


seed <- 151617182

fit_time_4cp_taph <- brm(
  model_fit_4cp,
  data = fit_df_taph,
  family = zero_inflated_poisson(),
  prior = prior_fit_4cp,
  
  stanvars = hinge_fun,
  
  chains = 1,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(8),
  backend = 'cmdstanr',
  seed = seed,
  
  sample_prior = 'yes'
)
```

```{r}
nd <- data.frame(time_ka = seq(min(fit_df$time_ka),
                               max(fit_df$time_ka),
                               0.1))

# draws x zones matrix for each nonlinear parameter
get_par <- function(par) posterior_linpred(fit_time_4cp, newdata = nd, nlpar = par)

p <- lapply(c("beta1","beta2","beta3","beta4", "beta5", "cp1","cp2","cp3", "cp4"),
            get_par)
names(p) <- c("beta1","beta2","beta3","beta4", "beta5", "cp1","cp2","cp3", "cp4")

# Slopes (log-rate per ka), oldest -> youngest segments
# Segment ordering assumes cp1 > cp2 > cp3 (older -> younger)
slopes <- list(
  seg_young_of_cp4   = p$beta1,                              # t < cp3
  seg_cp4_to_cp3     = p$beta1 + p$beta5,                    # cp3 < t < cp2
  seg_cp3_to_cp2     = p$beta1 + p$beta5 + p$beta4,          # cp2 < t < cp1
  seg_cp2_to_cp1     = p$beta1 + p$beta5 + p$beta4 + p$beta3,
  seg_older_than_cp1 = p$beta1 + p$beta5 + p$beta4 + p$beta3 + p$beta2 # t > cp1
)

summ <- function(m, name) {
  data.frame(
    quantity  = name,
    mean   = colMeans(m),
    median = apply(m, 2, median),
    lower  = apply(m, 2, quantile, 0.025),
    upper  = apply(m, 2, quantile, 0.975)
  )
}

cp_summary <- bind_rows(
  summ(p$cp1, "CP1 (Robberg/Oakhurst)"),
  summ(p$cp2, "CP2 (Oakhurst/Wilton)"),
  summ(p$cp3, "CP3 (Wilton/final LSA)"),
  summ(p$cp4, "CP4 (Wilton/final LSA)2")
) %>%
  distinct(quantity, mean, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    
    calBP_estimate = (-mean * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP),
    calBP_lwr = (-lower * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP),
    calBP_upr = (-upper * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP)
  )

slope_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(names(slopes), 
                                  function(n) summ(slopes[[n]], n))) %>%
  distinct(quantity, mean, .keep_all = TRUE)


# Slope change at each CP (just the hinge coefficient), with P(change > 0)
change_summary <- bind_rows(
  summ(p$beta5, "slope change at CP4"),
  summ(p$beta4, "slope change at CP3"),
  summ(p$beta3, "slope change at CP2"),
  summ(p$beta2, "slope change at CP1")
)  %>%
  distinct(quantity, mean, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r}
nd <- data.frame(time_ka = seq(min(fit_df$time_ka),
                               max(fit_df$time_ka),
                               0.1))

# draws x zones matrix for each nonlinear parameter
get_par <- function(par) posterior_linpred(fit_time_5cp, newdata = nd, nlpar = par)

p <- lapply(c("beta1","beta2","beta3","beta4", "beta5", "beta6",
              "cp1","cp2","cp3", "cp4", "cp5"),
            get_par)
names(p) <- c("beta1","beta2","beta3","beta4", "beta5", "beta6",
              "cp1","cp2","cp3", "cp4", "cp5")

# Slopes (log-rate per ka), oldest -> youngest segments
# Segment ordering assumes cp1 > cp2 > cp3 (older -> younger)
slopes <- list(
  seg_young_of_cp5   = p$beta1,                              # t < cp3
  seg_cp5_to_cp4     = p$beta1 + p$beta6,                    # cp3 < t < cp2
  seg_cp4_to_cp3     = p$beta1 + p$beta6 + p$beta5,          # cp2 < t < cp1
  seg_cp3_to_cp2     = p$beta1 + p$beta6 + p$beta5 + p$beta4,
  seg_cp2_to_cp1 = p$beta1 + p$beta6 + p$beta5 + p$beta4 + p$beta3,
  seg_older_than_cp1 = p$beta1 + p$beta6 + p$beta5 + p$beta4 + p$beta3 + p$beta2
)

summ <- function(m, name) {
  data.frame(
    quantity  = name,
    mean   = colMeans(m),
    median = apply(m, 2, median),
    lower  = apply(m, 2, quantile, 0.025),
    upper  = apply(m, 2, quantile, 0.975)
  )
}

cp_summary <- bind_rows(
  summ(p$cp1, "CP1 (Robberg/Oakhurst)"),
  summ(p$cp2, "CP2 (Oakhurst/Wilton)"),
  summ(p$cp3, "CP3 (Wilton/final LSA)"),
  summ(p$cp4, "CP4 (Wilton/final LSA)2"),
  summ(p$cp5, "CP5 (Wilton/final LSA)3")
) %>%
  distinct(quantity, mean, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    
    calBP_estimate = (-mean * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP),
    calBP_lwr = (-lower * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP),
    calBP_upr = (-upper * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP)
  )

slope_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(names(slopes), 
                                  function(n) summ(slopes[[n]], n))) %>%
  distinct(quantity, mean, .keep_all = TRUE)


# Slope change at each CP (just the hinge coefficient), with P(change > 0)
change_summary <- bind_rows(
  summ(p$beta6, "slope change at CP5"),
  summ(p$beta5, "slope change at CP4"),
  summ(p$beta4, "slope change at CP3"),
  summ(p$beta3, "slope change at CP2"),
  summ(p$beta2, "slope change at CP1")
)  %>%
  distinct(quantity, mean, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r}
pred_grid <- tibble(
  time_ka = seq(
    min(fit_df$time_ka, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(fit_df$time_ka, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 1000
  )
)

pred <- posterior_epred(
  fit_time_5cp,
  newdata = pred_grid,
  re_formula = NULL,
  allow_new_levels = TRUE
)


pred_summary <- pred %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  setNames(paste0("draw_", seq_len(ncol(.)))) %>%
  bind_cols(pred_grid) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("draw_"),
    names_to = "draw",
    values_to = "mu"
  ) %>%
  group_by(time_ka) %>%
  summarise(
    estimate = median(mu),
    lower = quantile(mu, 0.025),
    upper = quantile(mu, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(calBP = (-time_ka * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP)) %>%
  filter(calBP < 27000, calBP > 500)


###############################
# compute the slope summary
pred_grid_full <- tibble(
  time_ka = seq(
    min(fit_df$time_ka, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(fit_df$time_ka, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = nrow(fit_df)
  )
)

pred_full <- posterior_epred(
  fit_time_5cp,
  newdata = pred_grid_full,
  re_formula = NULL,
  allow_new_levels = TRUE
)



# Difference between adjacent time points
dt <- diff(pred_grid_full$time_ka)

# Posterior slope for each draw
slopes <- (pred_full[, -1] - pred_full[, -ncol(pred_full)]) /
  rep(dt, each = nrow(pred_full))

# Summarize posterior slopes
slope_summary <- data.frame(
  time_ka = pred_grid_full$time_ka[-1] -
    dt / 2,
  slope_mean = colMeans(slopes),
  slope_lower = apply(slopes, 2, quantile, 0.025),
  slope_upper = apply(slopes, 2, quantile, 0.975)
) %>%
  mutate(calBP = (-time_ka * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP))

slope_at_origin <- boundaries %>%
  filter(RFZ == 'ZA') %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    slope_summary %>%
      slice_min(
        abs(calBP - Origin),
        n = 1
      ) %>%
      select(slope_mean, slope_lower, slope_upper)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


slope_at_termination <- boundaries %>%
  filter(RFZ == 'ZA') %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    slope_summary %>%
      slice_min(
        abs(calBP - Termination),
        n = 1
      ) %>%
      select(slope_mean, slope_lower, slope_upper)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


slope_at_boundaries <- rbind(slope_at_origin,
                             slope_at_termination)
```

```{r}
fit_time_5cp_gg <- 
  ggplot() +
  
  # Where the slope is no different than 0
  geom_segment(
    data = slope_summary %>%
      mutate(calBP = round(calBP)) %>%
      filter((slope_upper < 0 & slope_lower > 0) | 
               (slope_upper > 0 & slope_lower < 0)) %>%
      inner_join(
        pred_summary %>%
          mutate(calBP = round(calBP)),
        by = "calBP"
      ), 
    aes(
      x = calBP,
      xend = calBP,
      y = lower,
      yend = upper
    ),
    color = "red"
  ) +
  
  # Reset color scale
  new_scale_color() +
  
  geom_rect(data = cp_summary,
            aes(xmin = calBP_upr, xmax = calBP_lwr, 
                ymin = 0, ymax = 0.4),
            alpha = 0.3) +
  
  # Observed site counts
  geom_segment(
    data = fit_df %>% filter(calBP > 500, calBP < 27000, site_count > 0),
    aes(
      x = calBP,
      xend = calBP,
      y = -0.02,
      yend = 0,
      color = site_count
    ),
    linewidth = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  
  scale_color_gradient(
    low = "grey85",
    high = "orangered",
    name = "Site count"
  ) +
  
  # Reset color scale
  new_scale_color() +
  
  # Bayesian credible interval
  geom_ribbon(
    data = pred_summary,
    aes(
      x = calBP,
      ymin = lower,
      ymax = upper
    ),
    alpha = 0.25,
    fill = "black",
    color = NA
  ) +
  
  # Posterior mean prediction
  geom_line(
    data = pred_summary,
    aes(
      x = calBP,
      y = estimate
    ),
    linewidth = 0.3,
    color = 'black'
  ) +
  
  # Robberg 
  geom_errorbar(data = boundaries %>% filter(RFZ == 'ZA'),
                aes(xmin = Termination, 
                    xmax = Origin,
                    y = 0.6, color = factor(Industry)), 
                position = 'dodge',
                width = 0.05, 
                linewidth = 0.5) +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Robberg" = "orange",
      "Oakhurst" = "blue",
      "Wilton" = "darkgreen",
      'Final LSA' = "magenta"
    ),
    name = "Technological\nPeriod"
  ) +
  
  # Reset color scale
  new_scale_color() +
  
  # Reverse BP axis
  scale_x_reverse() +
  
  labs(
    x = "Calibrated Years BP",
    y = 'Expected Radiocarbon Count',
    fill = "Site Count"
  ) +
  ylim(-0.02, 0.8) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  
  theme(
    # Reduce the font size of the legend title
    legend.title = element_text(size = 5), 
    
    # Reduce the font size of the legend labels
    legend.text = element_text(size = 4),
    
    # Shrink the size of the keys (the symbols/boxes)
    legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    
    
    axis.title = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 5)
  )
```

```{r}
my_prior <-
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = 'Intercept')+
  
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = 'b', coef = 'stime_ka:Zone_NameS_1')+
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = 'b', coef = 'stime_ka:Zone_NameW_1')+
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = 'b', coef = 'stime_ka:Zone_NameY_1')+
  
  prior(exponential(1), class = 'sd', coef = 'Intercept', group = 'Zone_Name')+
  
  prior(beta(1, 1), class = 'zi')

seed <- 771795837
fit_time_rfz_s <- brm(
  site_count ~ 1 + s(time_ka, by = Zone_Name) + (1|Zone_Name),
  
  family = zero_inflated_poisson(),
  
  data = fit_df,
  
  prior = my_prior,
  
  chains = 1,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(8),
  backend = 'cmdstanr',
  seed = seed,
  
  sample_prior = 'yes'
)


seed <- 17111142

  site_count ~ 1 + s(time_ka, by = Zone_Name) + (1|Zone_Name),
  
  family = zero_inflated_poisson(),
  
  data = fit_df_taph,
  
  prior = my_prior,
  
  chains = 1,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(8),
  backend = 'cmdstanr',
  seed = seed,

)
```

```{r}
  newdata = pred_grid_full,
  re_formula = NULL,
  allow_new_levels = TRUE
)


slope_summary <- map_dfr(
  unique(pred_grid_full$Zone_Name),
  function(z) {
    
    # Select grid rows for this zone
    idx <- which(pred_grid_full$Zone_Name == z)
    
    # Extract posterior predictions
    zone_pred <- pred_full[, idx, drop = FALSE]
    
    # Time differences
    zone_time <- pred_grid_full$time_ka[idx]
    dt <- diff(zone_time)
    
    # Posterior slopes
    slopes <- (zone_pred[, -1, drop = FALSE] -
                 zone_pred[, -ncol(zone_pred), drop = FALSE]) /
      rep(dt, each = nrow(zone_pred))
    
    # Summarize
    tibble(
      Zone_Name = z,
      time_ka = (zone_time[-1] + zone_time[-length(zone_time)]) / 2,
      slope_mean = colMeans(slopes),
      slope_lower = apply(slopes, 2, quantile, 0.025),
      slope_upper = apply(slopes, 2, quantile, 0.975)
    )
  }
) |>
  mutate(
    calBP = ((-time_ka * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP)) + 0.5
  ) |>
  filter(calBP < 27000, calBP > 500)



slope_at_origin_w <- boundaries %>%
  filter(RFZ == 'W') %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    slope_summary %>%
      filter(Zone_Name == 'W') %>%
      slice_min(
        abs(calBP - Origin),
        n = 1
      ) %>%
      select(slope_mean, slope_lower, slope_upper)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

slope_at_origin_s <- boundaries %>%
  filter(RFZ == 'S') %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    slope_summary %>%
      filter(Zone_Name == 'S') %>%
      slice_min(
        abs(calBP - Origin),
        n = 1
      ) %>%
      select(slope_mean, slope_lower, slope_upper)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

slope_at_origin_y <- boundaries %>%
  filter(RFZ == 'Y') %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    slope_summary %>%
      filter(Zone_Name == 'Y') %>%
      slice_min(
        abs(calBP - Origin),
        n = 1
      ) %>%
      select(slope_mean, slope_lower, slope_upper)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


slope_at_termination_w <- boundaries %>%
  filter(RFZ == 'W') %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    slope_summary %>%
      filter(Zone_Name == 'W') %>%
      slice_min(
        abs(calBP - Termination),
        n = 1
      ) %>%
      select(slope_mean, slope_lower, slope_upper)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

slope_at_termination_s <- boundaries %>%
  filter(RFZ == 'S') %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    slope_summary %>%
      filter(Zone_Name == 'S') %>%
      slice_min(
        abs(calBP - Termination),
        n = 1
      ) %>%
      select(slope_mean, slope_lower, slope_upper)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

slope_at_termination_y <- boundaries %>%
  filter(RFZ == 'Y') %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    slope_summary %>%
      filter(Zone_Name == 'Y') %>%
      slice_min(
        abs(calBP - Termination),
        n = 1
      ) %>%
      select(slope_mean, slope_lower, slope_upper)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


slope_at_boundaries <- rbind(slope_at_origin_w,
                             slope_at_origin_s,
                             slope_at_origin_y,
                             
                             slope_at_termination_w,
                             slope_at_termination_s,
                             slope_at_termination_y)
```

```{r}
# Global change point
hinge_fun <- stanvar(
  scode = "
  real hinge(real x, real cp) {
    return fmax(0, x - cp);
  }
  ",
  block = "functions"
)


# Three change points per region
model_fit_rfz_3cp <- bf(
  site_count ~ alpha +
    beta1 * time_ka +
    beta2 * hinge(time_ka, cp1) +
    beta3 * hinge(time_ka, cp2) +
    beta4 * hinge(time_ka, cp3),
  
  alpha ~ 1,
  beta1 ~ 1 + Zone_Name,
  beta2 ~ 1 + Zone_Name,
  beta3 ~ 1 + Zone_Name,
  beta4 ~ 1 + Zone_Name,
  
  cp1 ~ 0 + Zone_Name,
  cp2 ~ 0 + Zone_Name,
  cp3 ~ 0 + Zone_Name,
  
  nl = TRUE
)


prior_fit_rfz_3cp <- c(
  
  # baseline
  prior(
    normal(0, 1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "alpha"
  ),
  
  # initial slope
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta1"
  ),
  
  # slope change at CP1
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta2"
  ),
  
  # additional slope change at CP2
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta3"
  ),
  
  # additional slope change at CP3
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta4"
  ),
  
  # CP1
  # third change point from Robberg to Oakhurst
  prior(
    normal(12, 0.5),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "cp1"
  ),
  
  # CP2
  # second change point from Oakhurst to wilton
  prior(
    normal(6.3, 0.5),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "cp2"
  ),
  
  # CP3
  # last change point from Wilton to final LSA
  prior(
    normal(2.12, 2),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "cp3"
  )
)

seed <- 98765

fit_time_rfz_3cp <- brm(
  model_fit_rfz_3cp,
  data = fit_df,
  family = zero_inflated_poisson(),
  prior = prior_fit_rfz_3cp,
  
  stanvars = hinge_fun,
  
  chains = 2,
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = 500,
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(8),
  backend = 'cmdstanr',
  seed = seed,
  
  sample_prior = 'yes'
)


seed <- 87654

fit_time_rfz_3cp_taph <- brm(
  model_fit_rfz_3cp,
  data = fit_df_taph,
  family = zero_inflated_poisson(),
  prior = prior_fit_rfz_3cp,
  
  stanvars = hinge_fun,
  
  chains = 2,
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = 500,
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(8),
  backend = 'cmdstanr',
  seed = seed,
  
  sample_prior = 'yes'
)
```

```{r}

zones <- levels(factor(fit_df$Zone_Name))
nd <- data.frame(Zone_Name = factor(zones, levels = levels(factor(fit_df$Zone_Name))),
                 time_ka = 0)

# draws x zones matrix for each nonlinear parameter
get_par <- function(par) posterior_linpred(fit_time_rfz_3cp, newdata = nd, nlpar = par)

p <- lapply(c("beta1","beta2","beta3","beta4","cp1","cp2","cp3"), get_par)
names(p) <- c("beta1","beta2","beta3","beta4","cp1","cp2","cp3")

# Slopes (log-rate per ka), oldest -> youngest segments
# Segment ordering assumes cp1 > cp2 > cp3 (older -> younger)
slopes <- list(
  seg_young_of_cp3   = p$beta1,                              # t < cp3
  seg_cp3_to_cp2     = p$beta1 + p$beta4,                    # cp3 < t < cp2
  seg_cp2_to_cp1     = p$beta1 + p$beta4 + p$beta3,          # cp2 < t < cp1
  seg_older_than_cp1 = p$beta1 + p$beta4 + p$beta3 + p$beta2 # t > cp1
)

summ <- function(m, name) {
  data.frame(
    Zone_Name = zones,
    quantity  = name,
    mean   = colMeans(m),
    median = apply(m, 2, median),
    lower  = apply(m, 2, quantile, 0.025),
    upper  = apply(m, 2, quantile, 0.975)
  )
}

cp_summary <- bind_rows(
  summ(p$cp1, "CP1 (Robberg/Oakhurst)"),
  summ(p$cp2, "CP2 (Oakhurst/Wilton)"),
  summ(p$cp3, "CP3 (Wilton/final LSA)")
) %>%
  mutate(
    
    calBP_estimate = (-mean * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP),
    calBP_lwr = (-lower * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP),
    calBP_upr = (-upper * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP)
  )


slope_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(names(slopes), function(n) summ(slopes[[n]], n)))

# Slope before/after each change point (younger vs older side), plus % change per ka
ba <- list(
  CP3_younger = slopes$seg_young_of_cp3,   CP3_older = slopes$seg_cp3_to_cp2,
  CP2_younger = slopes$seg_cp3_to_cp2,     CP2_older = slopes$seg_cp2_to_cp1,
  CP1_younger = slopes$seg_cp2_to_cp1,     CP1_older = slopes$seg_older_than_cp1
)
ba_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(names(ba), function(n) summ(ba[[n]], n)))
pct_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(names(ba), function(n) summ(exp(ba[[n]]) - 1, paste0(n, "_pct"))))

# Slope change at each CP (just the hinge coefficient), with P(change > 0)
change_summary <- bind_rows(
  summ(p$beta4, "slope change at CP3"),
  summ(p$beta3, "slope change at CP2"),
  summ(p$beta2, "slope change at CP1")
)
pd <- c(CP3 = colMeans(p$beta4 > 0), CP2 = colMeans(p$beta3 > 0), CP1 = colMeans(p$beta2 > 0))

print(change_summary)
```

### 4 CP

```{r}
# Global change point
hinge_fun <- stanvar(
  scode = "
  real hinge(real x, real cp) {
    return fmax(0, x - cp);
  }
  ",
  block = "functions"
)

hinge <- function(x, cp) {
  pmax(0, x - cp)
}

# Three change points per region
model_fit_4cp <- bf(
  site_count ~ alpha +
    beta1 * time_ka +
    beta2 * hinge(time_ka, cp1) +
    beta3 * hinge(time_ka, cp2) +
    beta4 * hinge(time_ka, cp3) +
    beta5 * hinge(time_ka, cp4) ,
  
  alpha ~ 1,
  beta1 ~ 1+ Zone_Name,
  beta2 ~ 1+ Zone_Name,
  beta3 ~ 1+ Zone_Name,
  beta4 ~ 1+ Zone_Name,
  beta5 ~ 1+ Zone_Name,
  
  cp1 ~ 0 + Zone_Name,
  cp2 ~ 0 + Zone_Name,
  cp3 ~ 0 + Zone_Name,
  cp4 ~ 0 + Zone_Name,
  
  nl = TRUE
)


prior_fit_4cp <- c(
  
  # baseline
  prior(
    normal(0, 1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "alpha"
  ),
  
  # initial slope
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta1"
  ),
  
  # slope change at CP1
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta2"
  ),
  
  # additional slope change at CP2
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta3"
  ),
  
  # additional slope change at CP3
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta4"
  ),
  
  # additional slope change at CP4
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta5"
  ),
  
  # CP1
  # third change point from Robberg to Oakhurst
  prior(
    normal(14, 0.5),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "cp1"
  ),
  
  # CP2
  # second change point from Oakhurst to wilton
  prior(
    normal(9.21, 0.5),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "cp2"
  ),
  
  # CP3
  # last change point from Wilton to final LSA
  prior(
    normal(4.96, 2),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "cp3"
  ),
  
  # CP4
  # last change point from Wilton to final LSA
  prior(
    normal(-7.25, 2),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "cp4"
  )
)

seed <- 150016172

fit_time_rfz_4cp <- brm(
  model_fit_4cp,
  data = fit_df,
```

```{r}
p <- lapply(c("beta1","beta2","beta3","beta4", "beta5", "cp1","cp2","cp3", "cp4"),
            get_par)
names(p) <- c("beta1","beta2","beta3","beta4", "beta5", "cp1","cp2","cp3", "cp4")

# Slopes (log-rate per ka), oldest -> youngest segments
# Segment ordering assumes cp1 > cp2 > cp3 (older -> younger)
slopes <- list(
  seg_young_of_cp4   = p$beta1,                              # t < cp3
  seg_cp4_to_cp3     = p$beta1 + p$beta5,                    # cp3 < t < cp2
  seg_cp3_to_cp2     = p$beta1 + p$beta5 + p$beta4,          # cp2 < t < cp1
  seg_cp2_to_cp1     = p$beta1 + p$beta5 + p$beta4 + p$beta3,
  seg_older_than_cp1 = p$beta1 + p$beta5 + p$beta4 + p$beta3 + p$beta2 # t > cp1
)

summ <- function(m, name) {
  data.frame(
    Zone_Name = zones,
    quantity  = name,
    mean   = colMeans(m),
    median = apply(m, 2, median),
    lower  = apply(m, 2, quantile, 0.025),
    upper  = apply(m, 2, quantile, 0.975)
  )
}

cp_summary <- bind_rows(
  summ(p$cp1, "CP1 (Robberg/Oakhurst)"),
  summ(p$cp2, "CP2 (Oakhurst/Wilton)"),

  summ(p$cp4, "CP4 (Wilton/final LSA)2")
) %>%
  mutate(
    calBP_estimate = (-mean * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP),
    calBP_lwr = (-lower * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP),
    calBP_upr = (-upper * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP)
  )

# Slope change at each CP (just the hinge coefficient), with P(change > 0)
change_summary <- bind_rows(
  summ(p$beta5, "slope change at CP4"),
  summ(p$beta4, "slope change at CP3"),
  summ(p$beta3, "slope change at CP2"),
  summ(p$beta2, "slope change at CP1")
)  %>%
  distinct(quantity, mean, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r}
pred_grid <- tibble(
  time_ka = seq(
    min(fit_df$time_ka, na.rm = TRUE),

    length.out = 100
  )
) %>%
  expand_grid(
    Zone_Name = unique(fit_df$Zone_Name)
  )

pred <- posterior_epred(
  fit_time_rfz_4cp,
  newdata = pred_grid,
  re_formula = NULL,
  allow_new_levels = TRUE
)


pred_summary <- pred %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  setNames(paste0("draw_", seq_len(ncol(.)))) %>%
  bind_cols(pred_grid) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("draw_"),
    names_to = "draw",
    values_to = "mu"
  ) %>%
  group_by(time_ka, Zone_Name) %>%
  summarise(
    estimate = median(mu),
    lower = quantile(mu, 0.025),
    upper = quantile(mu, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(calBP = (-time_ka * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP)) %>%
  
  filter(calBP < 27000, calBP > 1500)


cp_summary <- cp_summary %>%
  mutate(Zone_Name = factor(Zone_Name))


png(paste0(dir, "/results/figures/Fig6A.png"), 
    width = 2200, height = 800, res = 300)

ggplot() +
  
  # Bayesian credible interval
  geom_ribbon(
    data = pred_summary,
    aes(
      x = calBP,
      ymin = lower,
      ymax = upper
    ),
    alpha = 0.25,
    fill = "black",
    color = NA
  ) +
  
  # Posterior mean prediction
  geom_line(
    data = pred_summary,
    aes(
      x = calBP,
      y = estimate
    ),
    linewidth = 1,
    color = 'black'
  ) +
  
  geom_rect(data = cp_summary,
            aes(xmin = calBP_upr, xmax = calBP_lwr, 
                ymin = 0, ymax = 0.4),
            alpha = 0.3) +
  # Robberg 
  geom_errorbar(data = boundaries, 
                aes(xmin = lwr, xmax = upr, y = 0.25,
                    color = Industry), 
                position = 'dodge',
                width = 0.05,
                linewidth = 1) +
  
  facet_wrap(~Zone_Name, scales = 'free') +
  
  # Reverse BP axis
  scale_x_reverse() +
  
  labs(
    x = "Calibrated Years BP",
    y = 'Radiocarbon Count',
    fill = "Site Count"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8)

dev.off()
```

### 5 CP

```{r}
# Global change point
hinge_fun <- stanvar(
  scode = "
  real hinge(real x, real cp) {
    return fmax(0, x - cp);
  }
  ",
  block = "functions"
)


# Three change points per region
model_fit_5cp <- bf(
  site_count ~ alpha +
    beta1 * time_ka +
    beta2 * hinge(time_ka, cp1) +
    beta3 * hinge(time_ka, cp2) +
    beta4 * hinge(time_ka, cp3) +
    beta5 * hinge(time_ka, cp4) +
    beta6 * hinge(time_ka, cp5),
  
  alpha ~ 1,
  beta1 ~ 1 + Zone_Name,
  beta2 ~ 1 + Zone_Name,
  beta3 ~ 1 + Zone_Name,
  beta4 ~ 1 + Zone_Name,
  beta5 ~ 1 + Zone_Name,
  beta6 ~ 1 + Zone_Name,
  
  cp1 ~ 0 + Zone_Name,
  cp2 ~ 0 + Zone_Name,
  cp3 ~ 0 + Zone_Name,
  cp4 ~ 0 + Zone_Name,
  cp5 ~ 0 + Zone_Name,
  
  nl = TRUE
)


prior_fit_5cp <- c(
  
  # baseline
  prior(
    normal(0, 1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "alpha"
  ),
  
  # initial slope
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta1"
  ),
  
  # slope change at CP1
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta2"
  ),
  
  # additional slope change at CP2
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta3"
  ),
  
  # additional slope change at CP3
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta4"
  ),
  
  # additional slope change at CP4
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta5"
  ),
  
  # additional slope change at CP5
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta6"
  ),
  
  # CP1
  # third change point from Robberg to Oakhurst
  prior(
    normal(14, 0.5),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "cp1"
  ),
  
  # CP2
  # second change point from Oakhurst to wilton
  prior(
    normal(9.21, 0.5),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "cp2"
  ),
  
  # CP3
  # last change point from Wilton to final LSA
  prior(
    normal(4.96, 2),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "cp3"
  ),
  
  # CP4
  # last change point from Wilton to final LSA
  prior(
    normal(-7.25, 2),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "cp4"
  ),
  
  # CP5
  # last change point from Wilton to final LSA
  prior(
    normal(-10, 1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "cp5"
  )
)

seed <- 15777643

fit_time_rfz_5cp <- brm(
  model_fit_5cp,
  data = fit_df,
  family = zero_inflated_poisson(),
  prior = prior_fit_5cp,
  
  stanvars = hinge_fun,
  
  chains = 1,
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = 500,
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(8),
  backend = 'cmdstanr',
  seed = seed,
  
  sample_prior = 'yes'
)


seed <- 18171823

fit_time_rfz_5cp_taph <- brm(
  model_fit_5cp,
  data = fit_df_taph,
  family = zero_inflated_poisson(),
  prior = prior_fit_5cp,
  
  stanvars = hinge_fun,
  
  chains = 1,
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = 500,
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(8),
  backend = 'cmdstanr',
  seed = seed,
  
  sample_prior = 'yes'
)
```

```{r}
    calBP_upr = (-upper * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP)
  )

slope_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(names(slopes), 
                                  function(n) summ(slopes[[n]], n)))


# Slope change at each CP (just the hinge coefficient), with P(change > 0)
change_summary <- bind_rows(
  summ(p$beta6, "slope change at CP5"),
  summ(p$beta5, "slope change at CP4"),
  summ(p$beta4, "slope change at CP3"),
  summ(p$beta3, "slope change at CP2"),
  summ(p$beta2, "slope change at CP1")
)
```

# Leave One Out Cross Validation

```{r}
site_sensitivity %>%
  filter(max_k > 0.2) %>%
  distinct(Site) -> sites
```

```{r}
my_prior <-
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = 'Intercept')+
  
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = 'b', coef = 'time_ka')+
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = 'b', coef = 'RFZS')+
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = 'b', coef = 'RFZW')+
  
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = 'b', coef = 'time_ka:RFZS')+
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = 'b', coef = 'time_ka:RFZW')+
  
  prior(exponential(1), class = 'sd', coef = 'Intercept', group = 'RFZ')+
  
  prior(inv_gamma(0.4, 0.3), class = 'shape')


seed <- 1777

jackknife_results <- vector("list", length(sites))
#j_TMP <- jackknife_results

for(i in 1:length(sites$Site)) {
  
  site_i <- sites$Site[i]
  
  message(
    "Fitting ", i, "/", length(sites$Site),
    ": leaving out ", site_i
  )
  
  dat_i <- fit_df %>%
    filter(Site != site_i)
  
  fit_i <- brm(
    site_count ~ 1 + time_ka * RFZ + (1 | RFZ),
    
    family = negbinomial(),
    
    data = dat_i,
    
    prior = my_prior,
    
    chains = 1,
    iter = 4000,
    warmup = 2000,
    
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
    
    cores = 4,
    threads = threading(8),
    
    backend = "cmdstanr",
    seed = seed + i
  )
  
  jackknife_results[[i]] <- list(
    site_removed = site_i,
    fit = fit_i
  )
}
```

```{r}
for(i in jackknife_results){

) +
```
